root.label: Botham Jean family files lawsuit against City of Dallas

events.label: Botham Jean family files lawsuit against City of Dallas

slots.name: damages amount
slots.sentence: In March 2026, Jean's family filed a civil lawsuit against the City of Dallas asking for nearly $100 million in damages.

slots.name: shift length
slots.sentence: The suit claims the city tried to cover up staffing gaps by assigning officers overtime work, leading to fatigue and stress, noting Guyger had clocked out from a nearly 14-hour shift on the night she killed Jean.
